copy.description:
Snack time and bath time can both get messy. This four-zone lick mat has four separate textured areas, according to the maker, for peanut butter, yogurt, kibble, and meat treats.

The maker describes the mat as food-grade flexible silicone that measures 7.9 by 5.9 inches. It is listed in yellow with a weight of 180 g. Its suction cups, according to the maker, stick to smooth surfaces such as tiles, bathtub walls, and floors, so the mat can stay in place during bathing, grooming, or feeding.

The maker says it is dishwasher safe, or you can rinse it with warm water after use.

Supervise every use. Stop using the mat and remove it if it is torn, cracked, or has loose parts, since small pieces can be a choking hazard. Avoid spreads that contain xylitol.

Ships from a US warehouse, and the shipping window is listed in the FAQ below.

faq.q: Can I leave my pet alone with the lick mat?
faq.a: No. Supervise your pet every time they use it, and stop use if the mat is damaged.

faq.q: Can I use any spread on it?
faq.a: No. Avoid spreads that contain xylitol. Check the label of any spread before you use it.
Estimate: 3–7 days to the US after 1–3 days of processing. Ships from a US warehouse.

copy.safety_warning: Choking hazard. Supervise your pet every time they use this mat. Stop use and remove the mat if it is torn, cracked, or has loose parts. Avoid spreads that contain xylitol.
